name: Flashcards
description: Spaced-repetition flashcards: create from canvas pages, PDFs, and photos; study with SM-2 scheduling; discuss cards with the AI; track progress.

flashcards.dailyNewLimit.description: How many NEW cards one study session introduces. This is a batch size, not a daily ceiling: finishing a session and starting another hands you the next batch, and Custom Study reaches the rest directly.

flashcards.dailyReviewLimit.description: How many due review cards one study session serves. A batch size, not a daily ceiling.

flashcards.paceNewCards.description: Pace new-card introduction to each deck's exam date: a session's new batch becomes the rate that finishes introducing every card before the freeze window. It shrinks below the batch size when there is time to spare, and RAISES above it when the deadline needs more - a large deck would otherwise never finish, and the deck card would only show a completion date past the exam. The deck card says when a rate was raised. Decks without an exam date keep the fixed batch.

flashcards.freezeDays.description: Days before the exam when new-card introduction stops and sessions become pure review. The pacing rate is computed to land every card before this window opens.

flashcards.generationDensity.description: How selective AI card generation is when the count is Auto. 'thorough' = one card per atomic fact; 'balanced' = every core concept gets a card, minor detail consolidates; 'lean' = exam-critical methods, formulas, and assumptions only. Density shapes selectivity across the whole material - it never truncates coverage mid-chapter.

flashcards.productionRecall.description: Let AI generation mark cards that should be ANSWERED rather than recognised, and give each one a rubric of the points a correct answer must make. A card is marked for a written answer whenever a correct response is a sentence rather than a bare name or number - definitions included; lists and formulas get their own answer types. Those cards ask you to type an answer, graded against the rubric and the source passage the card came from. Recognising a card you cannot actually state is the main way self-grading overstates what you know.

flashcards.productionDailyLimit.description: How many cards requiring a typed answer one study session serves. Counted separately from the review batch because a typed answer takes 30-60 seconds against roughly 5 for a recognition card, so mixing them into one allowance would quietly shrink how much you actually cover. 0 = no separate cap.

flashcards.leechThreshold.description: Lapses before a card is flagged as a leech (repeatedly failed; likely needs rewording).

flashcards.aiModel.description: Model id used for card generation and card discussion. Leave empty to use the chat's active model.

flashcards.generationContext.description: Context window (tokens) requested for card generation and discussion. 0 = auto: sized per run from the document length, card count, and the model's real context limit. Set a fixed value only to cap VRAM on smaller machines; material is clipped to fit whatever window is used.

flashcards.aiThinking.description: Let reasoning models (qwen3.x, DeepSeek-R1) think before writing cards or answering discussion questions. Slower per run; sometimes better on tricky material.

flashcards.dailyReminder.description: Schedule a daily background AI check that nudges you (via chat) when cards are due. Runs through the cron scheduler and respects the autonomy dial.

flashcards.reminderTime.description: Local wall-clock time (HH:MM) for the daily reminder check.
